objective: Measure runtime and verify outcome-blind dynamics health under the candidate parameters without a shuffled control or any landscape-effect estimate.

data_checksums.generated_inputs: SHA-256 values are written by the committed generator to workspace/matched_input_audit.json before execution

evidence_boundary: Runtime and health calibration only. This job has no shuffled control and cannot support C2-C4.
failure_policy: A failed health gate keeps the parameter lock in candidate status. Parameter changes may use only runtime, stability and health diagnostics, never a clustered-minus-shuffled effect.
